ache.title: Miguel’s big ultimate is doing the selling
ache.note: Nero translated Miguel’s kit from the Chinese site Gamekee and gushes over his ‘creeping barrage’ ultimate. Two hooks at once: info from servers ahead of you, so you plan pulls early, and a flashy animation made to be rewatched. Optimizing a unit you don’t own yet is really planning to spend.
watch: planning off servers ahead of yours
ache.tip: Enjoy the animation on YouTube. Watching it is free, and it’s the exact same animation.
lines: that ultimate is an ad with explosions

videoData.title: Miguel: Character Guide | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: In this episode, I provide a detailed character guide for Miguel from Sword of Convallaria, as requested by @Im_song_09. Using information sourced from the Chinese site Gamekee and translated for clarity, I explain Miguel's talents, passives, normal and active skills, as well as recommended builds and strategies for both PvP and PvM. I'll also review and comment on Miguel's skill animations, including his impressive creeping barrage ultimate. This guide aims to help players optimize Miguel's performance in the game.
